name: harness-seer
description: Runs Codex and Agy, read-only or with write access, and shows them with Claude subagents and background tasks in one animated pane, across sessions.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane
autoOpen.description: first-run: the first time a run starts in a session; never: only with /runs or the band's button.

usageShows.title: Usage shows
usageShows.description: Show each Codex and Agy usage window as percent used, the way Claude does, or as percent left, the way Codex does. Colours follow what is left either way, as in cache-seer.
